article.title: Why Customers Near a Rank Boundary Deserve Special Attention
article.why: Use distance to the next rank as one input to customer-development strategy.

paragraphs.en:
Membership programs often focus attention on the highest-spending customers. That is understandable: top customers already contribute substantial revenue and may deserve strong retention benefits. However, if the business objective is to move more customers into higher tiers, the most valuable intervention targets may be customers near a rank boundary rather than customers already far above it.

Consider a four-tier program based on annual spending. One customer is already well inside the highest tier. Another is only 20,000 yen below the threshold for the next tier. Giving both customers the same promotion may have very different strategic value. The first customer may have little reason to change behavior because the next benefit is already secured. The second customer has a visible, achievable goal and may respond to an incentive that helps close the gap.

This idea is sometimes described as focusing on the margin or boundary. Distance to threshold can be calculated for each customer and combined with recent spending pace, visit frequency, category breadth, and remaining time in the qualification period. A customer who is close to the threshold and still actively shopping may be more actionable than someone whose annual spending is higher but whose behavior is already stable.

However, proximity alone is not enough. Some customers are near a boundary by chance and have little capacity or desire to spend more. Others may reach the next tier naturally without any intervention. If the company rewards these customers, it may pay for behavior that would have happened anyway. This is why boundary targeting should eventually be connected to incremental-effect measurement rather than treated as a deterministic rule.

The threshold itself also matters. If the gap between tiers is too large, customers may perceive the next level as unreachable. If it is too small, too many customers may qualify without meaningful behavior change, increasing benefit costs. Good tier design balances exclusivity, attainability, customer motivation, and program economics.

For analysis, teams can create several candidate boundary bands, such as customers within 10,000, 30,000, or 50,000 yen of the next threshold. They can compare population size, historical rank-up rates, expected incremental spending, and benefit cost. A randomized campaign can then test whether showing progress, offering a temporary bonus, or recommending relevant categories actually increases movement.

The important point is that customer value and customer potential are not identical. High spend describes current value. Distance to a meaningful next step can help describe development potential. A mature membership strategy uses both: protect customers who are already valuable, while identifying customers for whom a realistic intervention could change future behavior.
paragraphs.zh:
會員制度常把注意力集中在最高消費顧客，這對 retention 很合理；但若目標是讓更多會員升級，最佳施策對象可能是接近 rank boundary 的顧客，而非早已遠高於門檻的人。

例如四級會員制中，一人已穩居最高層，另一人距下一層只差2萬日圓。同樣促銷對兩者的策略價值不同：前者可能已取得福利、沒有改變行為的理由；後者則有清楚且可達成的目標。

可計算每位顧客距下一 threshold 的差額，再搭配近期消費速度、來店頻率、category breadth 與資格期間剩餘時間。接近門檻且仍活躍的人，可能比消費更高但行為已固定的人更具 actionability。

但 proximity 本身不夠。有些人只是偶然靠近門檻，有些人即使不施策也會自然升級；若對後者發福利，就可能為原本會發生的行為付費。因此 boundary targeting 最終仍應接到 incremental-effect measurement。

門檻設計本身也重要。差距太大會讓下一級看似不可達，太小則可能讓大量顧客不需改變行為就升級，增加福利成本。實務上可建立距門檻1萬、3萬、5萬等候選 band，比較人數、歷史升級率、預期增量消費與 benefit cost，再用 randomized campaign 測試 progress 顯示、bonus 或 category recommendation 是否真的促進升級。

核心是 current customer value 與 development potential 並不相同。高消費描述現在價值，距下一個有意義門檻的距離則可幫助描述成長潛力。
paragraphs.ja:
会員制度では最高利用額の顧客に注目しがちです。retention目的なら合理的ですが、rank-upを増やす目的では、すでに上位rankの奥深くにいる顧客より、次のboundaryに近い顧客のほうが施策対象として有望な場合があります。

例えば4段階の制度で、一人は最高rankを十分超え、別の人は次rankまで2万円だとします。同じpromotionでも、前者はすでにbenefitを確保しているため行動変化の理由が小さく、後者には達成可能なgoalがあります。

顧客ごとにthresholdまでの差額を計算し、最近の利用pace、頻度、category breadth、判定期間の残り時間と組み合わせるとよいでしょう。boundaryに近く現在もactiveな顧客は、利用額が高くても行動が安定した顧客よりactionableかもしれません。

ただし近さだけでは不十分です。偶然boundary付近にいる人も、施策なしで自然にrank-upする人もいます。後者へのrewardは、本来起きる行動に費用を払うことになります。そのため最終的にはincremental effectを測る必要があります。

threshold設計も重要です。rank間が遠すぎれば達成不能に見え、近すぎれば行動変化なしで多くの顧客が昇格してbenefit costが増えます。1万円、3万円、5万円以内など複数bandを作り、人数、過去のrank-up率、incremental spend、costを比較し、randomized campaignでprogress表示やbonusが本当に行動を変えるか検証できます。

現在価値と成長potentialは同じではありません。高利用額は現在価値、意味のある次stepまでの距離は育成potentialを見る一つの軸です。

vocabulary.usage: Focus on customers near a rank boundary.
Measure distance to the next threshold.
Do not use proximity as a deterministic rule.
Tier design balances exclusivity and motivation.

business.term: Customer value and customer development potential are not identical.
business.explanation: 區分目前價值與可被施策提升的潛力。

sources: Loyalty-tier design principles; threshold-based targeting; randomized incremental-effect measurement.
